{{Top|leg}}
A '''sub-vert''' or '''subliminal''' was a short advert produced by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] to promote the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector's]] values and goals. It focused on subtle manipulation of the individual through images and wording. The effectiveness of sub-verts was not proven, but the Corporate Sector constantly used sub-verts in their media.
